points.point: Why carousel fails with collaborators error / what differs about carousels
points.sentence: They are **not supported on carousels** (multi-image/video posts) - a carousel with collaborators will fail to publish.

points.point: Collaborators work on single image posts
points.sentence: Collaborators are supported on **single image posts and reels**.

verdict.reason: The entry states collaborators are supported on single image posts but not carousels, which would fail to publish, so it answers the customer's question about the difference.
